```{r}
## Limpeza inicial
rm(list = ls())
```


```{r setup, include = FALSE}
## Bibliotecas Necessárias
library(FootStats) ## remotes::install_github("salvnetto/DYNMO")
library(openxlsx)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
```


```{r Bases de Dados, include = FALSE}
## Histórico de partidas
matches = load_data("spain", "laliga", "match_history")
```


```{r}
## Gerando variável de resultado
matches$resultado <- factor(ifelse(matches$gf > matches$ga, 2,
                            ifelse(matches$gf == matches$ga, 1, 0)))

## Gerando indicadora de mandante
matches$home = 0
matches$home[which(matches$venue == 'Home')] = 1

## Gerando indicadoras de efeito defesa e ataque
matches$atk = 1
matches$def = -1

## Filtrando por temporada
matches = matches %>% subset(season == "2024-2025")

## Filtrando por mandante
matches = matches %>% subset(venue == "Home")
```


```{r}
## Exportando os dados
write_xlsx(x = matches, path = '_dta/matches La Liga 2025-2024.xlsx')
```


```{r}
## Limpeza final
unloadNamespace('FootStats')
rm(list = ls())
```
